The '''1984–85 Serie A''' season heralded [[Hellas Verona]]'s first and so far only {{lang|it|Scudetto}}. Unusually, none of the big three of [[Juventus FC|Juventus]], [[A.C. Milan|Milan]] or [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]] managed to finish in the top two. [[Ascoli Calcio 1898|Ascoli]], [[S.S. Lazio|Lazio]] and [[U.S. Cremonese|Cremonese]] all were relegated to [[Serie B]]. Italy had one more place from the [[UEFA ranking]].

It was the only season when referees were assigned to matches by way of a random draw instead of being assigned to a specific match by a special commission of referees ({{lang|it|designatori arbitrali}}). After the betting scandal of the early 1980s (the {{lang|it|calcioscommesse}} scandal) it had been decided to clean up the image of Italian football by assigning referees randomly instead of picking them, in order to clear up all the suspicions and accusations.

==Teams==
[[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]], [[Calcio Como|Como]] and [[US Cremonese|Cremonese]], all from [[Lombardy]], had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
